### The Blood of Forgiveness and Cleansing (Hebrews 9:22) - Your Daily Bible Verse - October 14
Author: Roy Lessin
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/the-blood-of-forgiveness-and-cleansing-bible-study-minute-april-23-2018.html
Passage: Hebrews 9:22
Points:
- The first Passover required applying the blood of a slain lamb to escape God's judgment of death.
- God established the blood sacrifice to foreshadow His sinless Lamb, Jesus, who died as our substitute.
- Human efforts cannot remove the permanent stain of sin from our hearts.
- Through Christ's shed blood, believers receive both complete forgiveness and thorough spiritual cleansing.
- When God pardons us through Jesus' blood, He wipes the record clean and remembers our sins no more.
